records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner#1
records.source: Screens such as ``DbBrowserScreen``, ``PlateViewScreen`` and ``ReportScreen`` previously each had their own copy of this logic, and the copies differed: two connected ``thread.finished`` to a *closure*, which never retires the job (see ``JobRunner._retire_finished_jobs``). This module implements the rules once, for any screen that moves work off the GUI thread.
records.context: Application views such as ``DbBrowserScreen``, ``PlateViewScreen`` and ``ReportScreen`` previously each had their own copy of this logic, and the copies differed: two connected ``thread.finished`` to a *closure*, which never retires the job (see ``JobRunner._retire_finished_jobs``). This module implements the rules once, for any application view that moves work off the main GUI execution path.
records.translation: ``DbBrowserScreen``, ``PlateViewScreen``, ``ReportScreen`` 같은 화면에는 이전에 이 로직의 사본이 각각 있었고, 구현도 서로 달랐습니다. 두 구현은 ``thread.finished`` 를 *클로저*에 연결했는데, 이 방식은 완료된 작업을 정리하지 못했습니다(``JobRunner._retire_finished_jobs`` 참조). 이 모듈은 GUI 스레드 밖으로 작업을 옮기는 모든 화면에 적용할 규칙을 한곳에서 구현합니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner#6
records.source: Result delivery and thread retirement are separate. :meth:`JobRunner.cancel` clears pending deliveries immediately; a late completion then emits no ``job_finished`` signal. The finished-thread sweep still releases the thread references independently.
records.context: Result delivery and independent execution path retirement are separate. :meth:`JobRunner.cancel` clears pending deliveries immediately; a late completion then emits no ``job_finished`` signal. The finished-independent execution path sweep still releases the independent execution path references independently.
records.translation: 결과 전달과 스레드 참조 정리는 서로 독립적입니다. :meth:`JobRunner.cancel` 메서드는 대기 중인 전달을 즉시 지우므로 늦게 도착한 완료 알림은 ``job_finished`` 신호를 내보내지 않습니다. 종료된 스레드의 정리 순회는 이와 별개로 스레드 참조를 계속 해제합니다.
